real_interview.content: IntroV4Confirmation (hi i'm ellie thanks for coming in today i was created to talk to people in a safe and secure environment i'm not a therapist but i'm here to learn about people and would love to learn about you i'll ask a few questions to get us started and please feel free to tell me anything your answers are totally confidential are you ok with this)
how_doingV (so how are you doing today)
uh i'm from middle of nowhere iowa
when_LA (when did you move to l_a)
may second of two thousand seven
so exactly five years six years ago
often_backB (how often do you go back to your hometown)
infrequently like once every couple years
compares_LA (how does it compare to l_a)
uh the weather exists so it's more extreme
why_LA (why did you move to l_a)
adapted_LA (how easy was it for you to get used to living in l_a)
the drive in that's that's about all it took the lights uh
the lights took care of the rest
like_about_LA (what are some things you really like about l_a)
i really love that it's a giant concrete playground at nighttime so that bycicles uh
have free rein of the streets i like all the art i love
the fact that there's so many different kinds of culture jammed all together and that if you look hard enough you can find anything you really want here
dont_like_LA (what are some things you don't really like about l_a)
the exceedingly high cost of living
yeah those are those are my big beefs
travel_shoes (i'm sure you can tell by my shoes i'm not much of a world explorer do you travel a lot)
uh not nearly as much as i would like to
travel_changed (what do you enjoy about traveling)
knowing exactly how things are gonna go i like the fact that it forces me to
deal with situations in ways that i normally wouldn't have to
travel_trips (i'd love to hear about one of your trips)
hang out in san marcos for a little bit
after i split up with my ex
after san marcos i went back to iowa for a bunch of family stuff and then i brought my little brother to los angeles
memorableB (what's one of your most memorable experiences)
managed to go on a bike ride for cyclavia
as a <laughter> he was basically a rolling green light the entire way down venice boulevard and so he made he made a bunch of like
he was all over the place but the rest of us as his support group
riding around on tall bikes and stuff the we didn't
bat an eye we didn't blink because this is this is normal for our friends that wasn't even the most absurd thing he's done lately that was just a a happy normal sunday
is so unusual that a normal sunday for us is extreme for everyone else
great_situation (that sounds like a great situation)
shyoutgoing (do you consider yourself more shy or outgoing)
i used to be an introvert but definitely an extrovert the last few years thank you los angeles
tell_about_that (can you tell me about that)
once i found the right group of friends
it was easy to be social it it
drew me to be social extroverted even outgoing
bombastic for the first time and it stuck
relax_fishtank (sometimes when i'm feeling tense i turn on the fish tank screensaver hey i know it's not hawaii but it's the best i've got what do you do to relax)
if i weren't already the most relaxed guy already i would probably do things but when i'm really stressed out
i i do all sorts of stuff
usually i try to enlist my friends to help me do an art project
control_temper (how are you at controlling your temper)
last_argument (when was the last time you argued with someone and what was it about)
describe_felt (how did you feel in that moment)
<laughter> panicked 'cause i really wanted to make him not hate me
i mostly uh mostly got by with
a couple of scrapes on my ego
situation_handled (tell me about a situation that you wish you had handled differently)
when that all went down i tried to to talk to him but i got distracted for the very first time that day and so instead of
verbal gloves up i managed to
take a whole bunch of words to the side of the head and fall over a trash can it was
feelguilty (what's something you feel guilty about)
i feel guilty about lots of stuff um
i feel guilty about eating more often than anything else
'cause i really love junk food it's really good i have very little food willpower 'cause i used to be a fat guy
hard_decisionB (tell me about the hardest decision you've ever had to make)
i'm not sure what the hardest decision i ever had to make was
uh made a lot of hard decisions
it was pretty hard to leave los angeles after my ex and my best friend did a whole bunch of nasty stuff
it wasn't even that hard 'cause it pushed me to do it so
change_directions (what made you decide to do that)
uh oh you know broken collarbone
severe pain get surgery on it it all seemed like it made sense at the time
memory_erase (tell me about an event or something that you wish you could erase from your memory)
i have lived a spoiled blessed life and if i changed anything then it wouldn't be the same universe i like this universe
family_relationship (tell me about your relationship with your family)
my little brother lives here he's awesome he's actually right outside waiting for me
my mom is crazy my dad is crazy everyone else is crazy i'm pretty crazy
since most of the rest of them live so far away don't really have to deal with them too much relationship is positive and sparce
influence_positive (who's someone that's been a positive influence in your life)
jackrabbit's been a pretty positive influence on me lately
tell_about_that (can you tell me about that)
well there's the part where she's intensely physically beautiful
hit me with the best inspiration words there's the part where she
actually works on the exact things that make me excited there's the part where she pops in and out of my life at the exact right instance and then there's the part
she is a hundred percent kind and caring
all of those things are really nice but then when you add to that and compound it with the fact that
<laughter> what a funny question how do i know them as though she's multiple people how did you know
easy_sleep (how easy is it for you to get a good night's sleep)
the hard part is going to bed but as soon as i get to to sleepland i'm pretty much there until an earthquake uh hits
poorly but then i'm a pro at it so it doesn't matter
sleep_affects (what are you like when you don't sleep well)
<deep breath> less verbose and that's about it my dark circles get slightly larger and i'm pretty much the exact same dude because i've been doing it most of my life
feel_lately (how have you been feeling lately)
uh so stoked that i might as well be on fire
uh i suppose the word is sardonic sense of humor
uh has managed to convince me of the
in the arthur c clark sense
eh it's my privilege to get to enjoy more time like this
behavior_changes (have you noticed any changes in your behavior or thoughts lately)
uh my excitement is increasing at an almost exponential rate
and i'm feeling more and more inspired all the time
if i could just work on the motivation i'd be set
ptsd_diagnosed (have you ever been diagnosed with p_t_s_d)
mm not since you asked me on the form a little while ago no
depression_diagnosed (have you been diagnosed with depression)
uh no i used to think i had it but who knows at this point that was awhile ago
tell_about_that (can you tell me about that)
i was very unhappy with most of my life for a very long time and then i moved to los angeles and
started having fun mm and then that's uh yeah the rest is ancient history
happy_lasttime (tell me about the last time you felt really happy)
<sigh> working on my shoes this morning was really nice doodling uh
an art project that all my friends
helped and put on that's that was really nice it's a nice feeling

that's a very good question i'm not actually sure i'll ask him later today though
